parts.text: Photorealistic cinematic still, 16:9. Medium shot of one young Indian man, about 25, short neat black hair, clean-shaven, warm brown skin, light-grey crew-neck t-shirt under an unbuttoned dark-navy overshirt, slim silver watch. He sits at a white desk in a bright, minimal Scandinavian home office with large windows, soft late-afternoon daylight, a small green plant, light oak shelves softly out of focus. He looks at a matte-black laptop with a slightly mischievous, curious half-smile. Shot on 50mm, shallow depth of field, clean premium tech-commercial colour grade with neutral whites and subtle green accents. No text, no logos, nothing on the laptop screen.
